_readme: Tool definitions for the Vapi assistant. In the dashboard, add each as a Custom Tool (type: function) and set the Server URL of each to https://YOUR-APP.up.railway.app/vapi/tools with your webhook secret. Or pass this array as `model.tools` via the Vapi API.

function.name: check_inventory
function.description: Search the dealership's live vehicle inventory. Returns up to 3 matches summarized for speech, with stock numbers. Use whenever the caller asks what's available.

model.description: Model name, e.g. Telluride, Sportage, EV6

trim.description: Trim level, e.g. SX Prestige, GT-Line

maxPrice.description: Caller's stated budget ceiling in dollars. Used only to filter — never state prices.

function.name: get_vehicle_details
function.description: Get full details for one specific vehicle by stock number or VIN: trim, mileage, colors, key features, and availability status.

function.name: create_service_request
function.description: Log a service appointment request after collecting all required details. The service team confirms the final time.

serviceType.description: e.g. oil change, tire rotation, recall

preferredWindow.description: Preferred day and time window, e.g. Thursday morning

function.name: create_sales_lead
function.description: Log a sales lead after collecting the caller's details. A product specialist follows up.

timeframe.description: When they plan to buy, e.g. this weekend, next month

tradeIn.description: Their current vehicle if trading in

notes.description: Budget signals or anything else relevant. Never quote prices back.

function.name: get_hours_and_location
function.description: Get department hours, the dealership address, and directions.

department.description: sales, service, or parts. Omit for all departments.

function.name: transfer_to_human
function.description: Get the right department's transfer number when the caller needs a human: pricing/financing/trade value questions, frustration, requests for a person, legal or complaint language, or repeated misunderstanding.

reason.description: Why the caller is being transferred
